เมื่อวันที่ 24 December 2025 เวลา 9.00 น: On 24 December 2025 at 9:00 a.m., in the Ratchadamnoen Room, Royal Princess Larn Luang Hotel, Bangkok, Emeritus Professor Dr. Surapol Issaragrisil, M.D., President of the Royal Society of Thailand, opened the academic forum "Revered Fellows, Sages of the Land, No. 14" and the brainstorming forum on the Royal Society's 5-Year Strategy, No. 3, on the occasion of the Royal Society's centenary. Dr. Suphalerk Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society of Thailand, delivered the report. A total of 147 people attended, including Fellows, Associate Fellows, executives and staff of the Office of the Royal Society, and speakers who are descendants and students of the revered Fellows.
เมื่อวันที่ 4 June 2026 เวลา 15.00 น. ณ: On 4 June 2026 at 3:00 p.m., in the 2nd-floor hall of the Office of the Royal Society, The Government Complex Commemorating His Majesty the King's 80th Birthday Anniversary, 5th December 2007, Dr. Suphalerk Phuphongsak, Secretary-General of the Royal Society of Thailand, presided over the unveiling of the floral offering, delivered words of blessing and signed birthday wishes before the portrait of Her Majesty the Queen on the auspicious occasion of the 4th Cycle Birthday Anniversary of Her Majesty Queen Suthida Bajrasudhabimalalakshana, 3 June 2026. Executives, civil servants and staff of the Office of the Royal Society attended the ceremony in full.
